description: Override the prior-year comparative for one or more statement lines with an audited figure. The prior-year column fills itself automatically from the previous year's Trial Balance read through the current groupings, so use this only when the audited financial statements differ from that figure (for example appropriations booked outside the ledger), or when there is no previous-year Trial Balance to derive from — ask your user for the audited figures in those cases.
name: save_py_values
title: Save prior-year comparatives
